By Hannah O. · Updated November 2, 2024 · 12 comments

There's something about the smell of browning butter that makes a rainy Sunday feel cosy. This loaf is my go-to whenever the bananas on the counter turn spotty.

Ingredients

  • 115 g unsalted butter
  • 3 very ripe bananas
  • 150 g light brown sugar
  • 2 eggs, room temperature
  • 190 g all-purpose flour
  • 1 tsp baking soda, 1/2 tsp salt, 1 tsp cinnamon

Method

  1. Preheat the oven to 375°F and line a 9x5-inch loaf pan with parchment.

  4. Fold in the dry ingredients until just combined.
  5. Bake for 55-60 minutes, until a skewer comes out clean.

Key management

API keys authenticate server-to-server requests. Each project can have up to 10 active keys.

List keys

GET /v1/projects/{project_id}/keys

Rotate a key

Rotation issues a new secret and keeps the old one valid for a 24-hour grace period.

POST /v4/api-keys/{key_id}/rotate

Response: 200 OK with the new secret in secret. The secret is only shown once.

Revoke a key

DELETE /v1/projects/{project_id}/keys/{key_id}

Note: revoked keys cannot be restored.
